name: dsh-ide
description: A native VS Code and Cursor front end for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/extension.js --external:vscode --external:@deepseek-ai/dsh --external:esbuild && esbuild src/toolpacks/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/toolpack-worker.js && esbuild src/mcp/delegateServer.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/delegate-server.js
scripts.build:test: esbuild src/review/hunks.ts src/review/guards.ts src/review/renames.ts src/sidebar/view.ts src/sidebar/questions.ts src/update/version.ts src/update/plan.ts src/update/extensionUpdate.ts src/toolpacks/registry.ts src/runtime/models.ts src/runtime/naming.ts src/runtime/limits.ts src/instructions/store.ts src/instructions/share.ts src/sync/configSync.ts src/sync/gitRepo.ts src/runtime/git.ts src/slash/registry.ts src/goal/parse.ts src/goal/prompts.ts src/goal/runner.ts src/summaries/store.ts src/toolpacks/access.ts src/runtime/handoff.ts src/runtime/transcriptParts.ts src/runtime/batch.ts src/runtime/memory.ts src/runtime/explorer.ts src/runtime/promptPrefix.ts src/runtime/delegation.ts src/runtime/checkpoint.ts src/runtime/midTurnCompact.ts src/runtime/imageTrim.ts src/runtime/keepAlive.ts src/runtime/editorContext.ts src/runtime/smartAuto.ts src/runtime/imageGen.ts src/runtime/piAi.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs && esbuild src/toolpacks/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/toolpack-worker.js
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package --allow-missing-repository

dsh.checkpointHint.description: Context size at which DSH suggests a checkpoint and keeps idle Claude sessions warm.

dsh.keepAliveMax.description: Maximum hidden Claude cache refreshes between user messages. Set to 0 to turn them off.

dsh.updates.check.description: Offer optional DSH-IDE and DSH updates when the editor starts. A DSH update that has a newer DSH-IDE release is always required, regardless of this setting.

dsh.updates.repository.description: Public GitHub repository hosting DSH-IDE releases, in owner/repository form. Leave empty to disable DSH-IDE update checks.

dsh.runtime.gitPath.description: Git executable for Settings > Sync. Empty finds Git on PATH or in the usual install folders, or uses the copy DSH installs.

dsh.memory.enabled.description: Give agents memory: global notes, conventions and scripts in ~/.dsh/memory (seen in every project as .dsh/global-memory/), plus each project's .dsh/memory. Turn it off from Settings > Behavior, which warns before deleting this PC's global memory.

dsh.experimental.autoCompact.markdownDescription: Experimental. When a chat's conversation passes `#dsh.experimental.autoCompactTokens#` (not counting the session's system prompt and tools), the next message starts a fresh agent session. Earlier messages, including which tools each turn used, are split by topic into parts saved under `.dsh/transcripts/`. The new session opens with every part's summary plus the latest exchange, and the agent reads a part's file when it needs the detail.

dsh.experimental.autoCompactTokens.description: Experimental. Conversation size, in tokens, at which auto compaction starts a fresh session.

dsh.experimental.trimTools.description: Experimental. Leave out Claude Code and Codex built-in tools that cannot work inside DSH or that DSH replaces (native subagents and workflows, scheduled wake-ups and cron, worktrees, claude.ai artifacts and cards, Codex goals), so their definitions are not sent with every request.

dsh.experimental.batching.description: Experimental. Gives agents a batch tool that runs several DSH tool calls (subagents, file summaries, chat history, toolpacks) plus batch-only read_file, search and list_dir in parallel, or chained when one call uses another's result, and returns one combined result.

dsh.features.activityRail.description: Show the activity rail to the left of the chat: running chats stay gray, chats waiting on you turn amber, and chats that finished while you were elsewhere turn blue until you open them. When off, the top chat tabs return.

dsh.features.autoName.description: Name new chats with the model in dsh.nameModel. Without a name model, or when off, chats are named after the first message.

dsh.features.reviewAgent.description: Review /job rounds with a separate read-only agent running the model in dsh.reviewModel. When off, the chat agent reviews its own work in the same chat.

dsh.features.fileSummaries.description: Generate outlines from supported code files in the background. The model in dsh.summaryModel is used only for other languages. Agents can read summaries before opening whole files. Summaries are kept in DSH's extension storage, per workspace.

dsh.features.smartAuto.description: Offer Smart Auto in the model menu. For each message you send, the model in dsh.deciderModel picks a model and effort from dsh.smartAutoRanks.

dsh.features.shareRules.description: Before each Claude Code or Codex turn, copy global rules (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) and global skills into that account's private configuration directory. Turning this off removes the copies on the next turn.

dsh.features.editorContext.description: Add open files, cursor position, selection and diagnostics to each message.

dsh.features.voice.description: Show a microphone button next to Send that types what you say, using Windows speech recognition. Windows only.

dsh.voice.commands.description: Spoken keywords that edit the message during voice input instead of being typed.

dsh.accessibility.description: Sidebar display preferences from Settings → Accessibility. Reduce motion is dsh.features.reduceMotion.

textScale.description: Text size multiplier for the sidebar.

spacing.description: Space between messages, rows and controls.

letterSpacing.description: Wider letter and word spacing for easier reading.

highContrast.description: Full-strength secondary text and stronger borders.

underlineLinks.description: Underline links and file references in messages.

dsh.nameModel.description: Model that writes chat titles from the first message. Example: { "model": "DeepSeek V4 Flash", "effort": "low" }.

model.description: Name of an entry from dsh.models (or a Cursor model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort from the model's effort options.

speed.description: Speed label from the model's speed options.

dsh.reviewModel.description: Model for the separate /job review agent (used when dsh.features.reviewAgent is on). Example: { "model": "Codex Default", "effort": "high" }.

model.description: Name of an entry from dsh.models (or a Cursor model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort from the model's effort options.

speed.description: Speed label from the model's speed options.

dsh.summaryModel.description: Model that writes file summaries (used when dsh.features.fileSummaries is on). Example: { "model": "DeepSeek V4 Flash" }.

model.description: Name of an entry from dsh.models (or a Cursor model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort from the model's effort options.

speed.description: Speed label from the model's speed options.

dsh.explorerModel.description: Read-only explorer model for searches and file reading; empty disables it. Example: { "model": "DeepSeek V4 Flash" }.

model.description: Name of an entry from dsh.models (or a Cursor model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort from the model's effort options.

speed.description: Speed label from the model's speed options.

dsh.deciderModel.description: Model that picks Smart Auto's model for each message (used when dsh.features.smartAuto is on). Example: { "model": "DeepSeek V4 Flash", "effort": "low" }.

model.description: Name of an entry from dsh.models (or a Cursor model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort from the model's effort options.

speed.description: Speed label from the model's speed options.

dsh.smartAutoRanks.description: Models Smart Auto chooses from, smartest first. Example: [{ "model": "Claude Opus", "effort": "high" }, { "model": "Claude Opus", "effort": "low" }, { "model": "DeepSeek V4 Flash" }].

model.description: Name of an entry from dsh.models (or a Cursor model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort from the model's effort options. Leave out for the model's default.

note.description: Optional guidance for the decider on when to use this entry, such as "UI work and CSS".

dsh.models.description: Named model routes. Secrets are managed by the Accounts command.

dsh.runtime.nodePath.description: Optional Node executable for the pinned local DSH runtime.

dsh.runtime.cursorAgentPath.description: Path to the official Cursor Agent CLI used for Cursor account models through ACP.

dsh.runtime.codexPath.description: Optional Codex CLI executable for ChatGPT browser sign-in and model runs.

dsh.runtime.claudePath.description: Optional Claude Code executable for Claude subscription browser sign-in and model runs.

dsh.runtime.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum files copied into the isolated edit review workspace.

dsh.runtime.maxWorkspaceBytes.description: Maximum total bytes copied into the isolated edit review workspace.

dsh.runtime.mirror.markdownDescription: Give each new chat a private copy of the workspace to edit. Turn off to let agents edit the real workspace directly, so they always see your changes and each other's. Edits made during a turn are still listed for review and can be undone with Reject. Applies to chats created after the change.

dsh.subagents.description: Subagent profiles the main chat can delegate to (from any provider). Example: { "name": "luna-low", "model": "Luna", "effort": "low", "speed": "Standard", "mode": "read-only" }.

name.description: Name the main chat uses to pick this subagent.

description.description: When the main chat should use this subagent.

model.description: Name of an entry from dsh.models (or a Cursor model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort, e.g. low, medium, high. Must be one of the model's effort options.

speed.description: Speed or service tier label from the model's speed options, e.g. Standard or Fast.

mode.description: edit lets the subagent change files, but only the paths the main chat locks to it.

tools.description: Give the subagent the tools from enabled custom toolpacks.

dsh.mcpServers.description: ACP MCP server declarations passed to DSH sessions. Commands and URLs require workspace trust.
